en: The enhanced version of the great game Orion Sandbox has arrived! You always need to survive on a virgin world by collecting materials, crafting tools and armor, making improvised shelters, successfully completing missions, finding treasures, and so on. The planet looks like a paradise by day, but when night comes, darkness can hide ferocious creatures and terrible secrets ... Shape the world like you want it! Will you be able to survive on this strange planet?
zh: 游戏佳作Orion Sandbox的加强版现已上市！在一个原始世界你要生存下来，收集材料、制作工具和盔甲，建造临时房屋，成功完成任务，寻找宝藏等。白天，星球犹如天堂一般，但一到晚上，在黑暗之中可能有恶魔和可怕秘密隐藏……任由你改造世界！你能在这个陌生的星球生存下来吗？

en: This game has real time day and night shift. In daytime sun is shining and creatures are crawling all over the place. But should the night befall, zombies rise to the land to hunt you. You will do well to find cover for the night. Use torches to light up things a bit.

en:
You can grow trees, vegetables, and flowers. You need a hoe, a watering can, seeds or seedlings for that.

First, till the dirt with a hoe. Then, fill the watering can with water to water the farmland. Finally, plant seeds or seedlings on the farmland. Don’t forget to water it once in a while to ensure it grows fast.
zh:
你可以种树、蔬菜和鲜花。为此，你需要有锄头、浇水壶、种子或树苗。

然后，给浇水壶装满水来灌溉农田。最后，在农田播下种子，或者种下小树苗。别忘了，要不时地浇水，这样它才长地快。

en:
• grow several flowers
• grow one tree

Your character has a health bar. Once it drops to zero you’ll die. You can restore health by eating meat or drinking healing potions. Fried meat restores twice as health as raw meat.

Your character needs armor for protection. It decreases the amount of damage your character gets from monsters. Wearing better armor provides better protection. Collecting the full set of armor provides the best protection. At first you’ll do well with leather armor.
zh:
你的角色有生命条。降至零，角色死亡。你可以吃肉或喝生命药剂恢复生命值。烤肉的治疗效果是生肉的一倍。

你的角色需要穿盔甲来获得保护。它可以减少角色被怪兽袭击时的受损伤度。越高级的盔甲的防护能力越好。收集的一整套装的盔甲具有最佳防护力。开始，穿皮甲即可满足你的需要。

杀死这个守卫，获得其古老的“道路之戒指”。戒指会指引你去别的超级怪物那里。

en:
When your character gains a level, the health will increase, and your character will have new possibilities. For instance, you need to be level 2 to use bronze equipment.

You need experience points to raise your level. You can get experience points by killing monsters. Grab some armor, a sword and off you go to the dungeons! Don’t forget that you lose some of your experience points when dying. Try not to die too often.
zh:
当你的角色升了一级，生命点数会增加，你的角色有新机会。例如，你要达到二级才可以使用铜装备。

你需要经验点来升级。可以通过杀怪兽获得经验点。穿上盔甲、拿起剑，前往地下城吧！别忘了，角色死亡会减少一些经验点。减少角色死亡次数。

en:
Bronze armor offers better protection than the leather one and has better durability. The same goes for the rest of the bronze equipment. A bronze pick axe can mine even more blocks than a  wooden one. It can also mine iron ore.

The quality of equipment depends on quality of materials. The best material is solidium. You need anvil to craft bronze items. You can craft a anvil using the workbench.
zh:
铜盔甲提供了比皮盔甲更好的保护和耐久度。铜镐比木镐开采更多砖块。它还可以开采铁矿石。装备的质量取决于制材。

最好的材料是超锢矿。你需要铁砧打造铜物品。你可以用工作台建造铁砧。

en:
• craft bronze sword
• craft bronze pickaxe
• craft the full set of bronze armor
zh:
打造铜剑
• 打造铜锄子
• 打造出一整套铜盔甲

en:
You can run across ore and energy crystals deep beneath the land. Use ore to craft various items and equipment. To use it, you first need to smelt it in a furnace. You can use wood or coal as fuel.

Venture deep under the surface of the planet to find bronze ore. Depending on how deep down you go, you can encounter valuable resources. You need enhanced tools to mine them. You can craft a furnace using the workbench.
zh:
在地下深处，你可能会遇到矿石和能量水晶。用矿石打造各种物品和装备。先需要在熔炉中炼矿石，然后才能使用。你可以用木头或煤作为燃料。

冒险深入地下找到铜矿。根据你下到的地下深度不同，可能遇上珍贵资源。你需要强化后的工具来开采它们。你可以用工作台建造一个熔炉。

en:
You can have a pet. You need a cage you can craft with anvil.

Catch a chicken and place it in the cage and craft a house for it using a workbench. You can place a chickenhouse.
zh: 你可以养宠物。你需要一个笼子。你可以用铁砧打造鸟笼。将抓来的鸡放入笼中，然后用工作台打造一个鸡舍。你可以放置鸡舍。

en: Explore the world and find the old lighthouse. The old merchant who lives there possesses ancient powerful artifacts that will help you survive on this planet.
zh: 探索世界，找到古代灯塔。居住在那里的老商人拥有古老、强大器物，可以帮助你在这个星球上生存。

en: It’s not necessary to engage in close combat to kill a monster. You can use a crossbow or a revolver to shoot from afar. Craft the crossbow and a few bolts on the workbench. Place bolts to the Ammo Slot.
zh: 要将怪物杀死，不一定要近距离战斗。你可以用十字弓或左轮手枪远距离射击。在工作台上制作一把十字弓和一些弓箭。将十字弓弓箭放在弹药槽。

en: • kill a few animals or monsters with a crossbow
zh: • 用十字弓杀死一些动物或怪物。

en: Only the registered player can become the greatest warrior and the best survivor. If you want to save this planet forever online, get special bonuses, and share you awesome screenshots, you know what you have to do...
zh: 只有已注册用户才能成为终极武士和最佳生存者。如果你想永远在线拯救这个星球，获得特别奖励，以及分享你精彩截屏，你当然知道怎么做。

en: Slay a King Mosquiton and you get 3D Printer 3000. You can swap resources to coal and ore there.
zh: 杀死莫斯奎登王，可以得到一台3D打印机 3000型。你可以在那用资源换取煤和矿石。

en: Slay a mighty Tyrant and claim Space Blaster.
zh: 杀死独裁者提蓝特，获得太空轰天枪。

en: Place a bed in your house and Right Click to activate it. Now you will spawn here if you die. But don’t get overexcited – death causes loss of some experience points.
zh: 在屋内放一张床，右击启用它。如果角色死亡，会在这里重生。但是别高兴地太早 — 角色死亡会丢失经验值。

en: The most powerful sword in the galaxy belongs to the great conqueror of the planets and stars. Destroy Imperator Finalium and take possession of this mighty artifact.
zh: 宇宙中威力最大的剑，宇宙之王所拥有之剑。打败费纳利姆大将军，获得这个强大的器物。

en: Open the workbench with <font color='#99D4FF'>[Right Click]</font> and craft a pickaxe.
zh: <font color='#99D4FF'>[右击]</font>打开工作台，然后打造一把镐。

en:
Be sure to read item description 
to learn its use.
zh: 一定要看看物品说明了解用途。

en: Open an inventory and create a workbench.
zh: 打开物品栏，建造一个工作台。

en:
You can use the workbench 
to craft various items.
zh: 你可以用工作台打造各种物品。

en:
Mine a block with <font color='#99D4FF'>[Left Click]</font> 
Hold it until the block breaks.
zh:
<font color='#99D4FF'>[左击]</font>可以开采砖块。
按住不放，待砖块碎裂。

en:
Some blocks can be mined 
with pickaxe only.
zh: 有些砖块只可用镐来开采。

en:
I can jump if you press <font color='#99D4FF'>[Space]</font> 
The longer you hold it the higher I jump.
zh:
如果你按 <font color='#99D4FF'>[空格键]</font> 
我就会跳跃。按住时间越久，跳得越高。

en:
Get some sheep’s fur. 
To attack the sheep <font color='#99D4FF'>[Left Click]</font> on it or to empty space toward it. 
Be sure to get cudgel with you.
zh:
获得一些羊皮。 
 <font color='#99D4FF'>[左击]</font>攻击羊，或在空处点击朝羊的地方运动。 
一定带上棒子。

en:
Well done! 
This concludes our tutorial.
zh:
好样的！ 
本次教程到此结束。

en: Try moving me with <font color='#99D4FF'>[A and D]</font>
zh: 要让我移动，可以 <font color='#99D4FF'>[A and D]</font>

en: I survived the crash! Unknown planet...
zh: 飞船坠落中我幸存下来！一个未知的星球

en:
Crawl into a dungeon and mine some cobblestone. 
Pickaxe is useless to dig dirt. 
Be sure to get torches and ladders with you.
zh:
下到地下城，采一些石材。 
镐挖不了土。 
一定带上火把和梯子。

en:
Use cobblestone to craft 
stone tools and weapons.
zh: 用石材打造石器工具和武器。

en:
Mine some wood 
from nearby trees.
zh: 从附近树上采一些木头。

en: Phew, that should do for a while.

Place a block of an empty space with <font color='#99D4FF'>[Left Click]</font> 
If grass is there, cut it.
zh:
<font color='#99D4FF'>[左击]</font> 
将一个砖块放在空地上。如地上有草，会被清除。

en:
Well done! Now you can try 
building a small house.
zh:
好样的！现在， 
你要来试着造一个小房子。

en:
Select the workbench on upper panel 
and place it on any block.
zh:
从上面板中选择工作台， 
然后放在任何砖块上。
好了，现在可以使用它了。

en: Your pickaxe is damaged. You should repair it.
zh: 你的镐损坏了。你应当修复它。

en:
At some point you’ll need to repair your 
equipment, weapons and armor as their durability drops.
zh: 在某一时候，你需要修复装备、武器和盔甲，因为它们的耐久度值会下降。

en:
Be sure to save planet 
before quitting the game.
zh: 退出游戏前，请务必保存星球信息。

zh: 它居住在地下很深的被遗弃的防空洞中。制作电池来启动它。

en: You can find Imperator Finalium on one of the last flying islands. Thousands of years ago great kings lived on these islands , and now there are only the deserted ruins.
zh: 在仅存空中岛屿之一上，你可以找到费纳利姆大将军。数千年前，伟大的国王住在这些岛上，如今却成了被遗弃的荒岛。

en: Tyrant. Mighty warrior who lives only for supreme power. All zombies fear and serve him.
zh: 暴君提蓝特。强大武士，一意当霸主。所有僵尸都服从和畏惧他。

en:
PART 1

A LONG TIME AGO GOBLINS WERE THE OWNERS OF THIS
PLANET. THEY CALLED IT VELIUM.

GOBLINS LIVED ON THE FLYING ISLANDS IN THE HUGE
CASTLES.

THEIR TECHNOLOGIES WERE GREAT. THERE WERE A LOT OF
UNIVERSITIES AND UNDERGROUND LABS.

BUT 300 YEARS AGO EVIL IMPERATOR FINALIUM INVATED THIS
PLANET WITH HIS STRONGEST GENERALS AND HUGE ARMY.

GOBLINS WERE DEFEATED.

THEIR LAST HOPE IS THE SPACE LIGHTHOUSE THAT SENDS
THE SIGNALS FOR HELP.

BUT THE HERO MUST HARRY BECAUSE IMPERATOR FINALIUM
CALLED...
zh:
第一篇：

很久很久以前，这个星球的主人是哥布林妖怪。他们将之称为伟里姆。

哥布林居住在巨大的城堡空中的岛屿上。

他们的科技很发达。兴办学院和位于地下的实验室。

不过，300年前，费纳利姆大将军率领强将及其千军万马入侵了这个星球。

哥布林战败而逃。

他们最后的希望是可以发送求救信号的宇宙灯塔。

但是，我们要赶紧行动，因为费纳利姆大将军已召集……

en:
PART 2

...THE SHADOW. AND IT IS ON THE PLANET ALREADY.
 IT HIDES AND WAITS.
 IT IS WAITING FOR THE HERO.


THE SHADOW DOES NOT HAVE A MATERIAL SHELL.
IT WILL ENTER INTO THE MOST DANGEROUS
 AND EVIL CREATURES ON THE PLANET
 AND MAKE THEIR POWER INCREDIBLE.


YOU MUST DEFEAT IT, IF YOU WANT TO SAVE THIS PLANET.
BUT HOW MANY PLANETS NEED YOUR HELP?


RECENTLY, SPACE LIGHTHOUSE RECEIVED
 A SIGNAL FROM ANOTHER PLANET.
THE PLANET...
zh:
第二部分

...影子。这早已存在在这个星球上了。
他们藏着、等着。
等着英雄到来。影子没有壳体。
他会进入最危险的地方
星球上最邪恶的生物
让他们获得无与伦比的力量。


你必须打败他。如果你想拯救这个星球的话。
但是有多少星球在等着你去拯救呢？


最近，太空灯塔接收到了
另一个星球的信息。
那个星球...
